fieldValues.title: A holon's rulings were written only in its issue body, so the owner's session could not show them
fieldValues.summary: Holon semanticops.com#49 settled seven rulings (R1-R7) in its parent issue. The owner went to ratify them and found nothing: 'how do i do the remaining ratifications? They don't appear in session'. The session agenda lists only proposed decision records in a decision log. The agent then wrote one proposed decision (9441693e) for the owner-level ruling and recorded the rule-settled ones on the issue citing their rule; the owner ratified it (srs-programme#345).
evidence: semanticops.com#49 body, section 'Decisions settled by principle', 2026-10-29
owner, 2026-10-29: how do i do the remaining ratifications? They don't appear in session
fieldValues.body:
- The holon handbook step 4 says to record each settlement on its issue, which is a store no session reads.
- Suggested change: in holon setup, every ruling that needs the owner is written as a proposed decision in the owning log at once (proposed decision 199dd369's placement rule), and only rule-settled ones stay as issue text citing the rule.
